method.sign: input map cell; checkerboard flips every 64 pixels, not every 16
method.frame_class: frame 0 first/uncompensated; frame >=1 compensated, including GOP1 I slices
method.quantiles: type 7, no rounding; per-cell distribution, not per-CU or frame-median quantiles
method.source_video: same run's fixed deterministic synthetic generator; dimensions/config/pin and frame/POC checked
method.inference: descriptive only; cells and repeated CRF/QP-label data are not independent replicates
